answer: Decaying Reputation-Bond (Willow Curve)** Each participant's standing is a decaying, non-transferable balance called quartz that accrues only through verified, asymmetric work; its decay rate resets upward with each new identity. The curve enforces that the marginal cost of standing for identity n+1 rises superlinearly, so a fable of "open participation" still yields real budgets. An attacker running k clones pays a per-identity cost that scales roughly with k^1.5 before any influence is recognized.
